classification.difficultyReason: Choose swapped matching sides in two equal included-side ratios, then transfer the scale to the unknown interval.

spec.description: Exact DABtriangle dimensionsDA2.4,DB3.3,AB3; EonDA ED2.2/EA.2, ConDB DC1.6/CB1.7; ECx. No false ECparallelAB mark: similarity swaps D-adjacent sides.

spec.answerVisibility: Original givens only; all computed values remain in answers.

children.label: a
children.prompt: In the diagram shown, name two triangles that are similar and state why they are similar.

answer.worked: The outer lengths are $DA=2.2+0.2=2.4\text{ m}$ and $DB=1.6+1.7=3.3\text{ m}$. Therefore $\frac{DE}{DB}=\frac{2.2}{3.3}=\frac{2}{3}$ and $\frac{DC}{DA}=\frac{1.6}{2.4}=\frac{2}{3}$. The included angle EDC equals BDA, so $\triangle DEC\sim\triangle DBA$ by SAS. E matches B and C matches A; do not assume EC is parallel to AB.

children.label: b
children.prompt: Write down the three equal ratios.

answer.worked: Match D with D, E with B and C with A in the similarity statement. Thus the three ratios of matching inner to outer sides are $\frac{EC}{BA}=\frac{ED}{BD}=\frac{DC}{DA}=\frac{2}{3}$.
